text:
Sarah (AE): Quick thread to coordinate Hooper POC orderflow. They want 30-day POC, PO on envelope, and DPA tweaks for KMS/HSM. Who can own signer mapping?
Tom (Sales Eng): POC scoping doc uploaded: https://drive.redwood/hooper/poc-scoping (view).
Sarah (AE): Procurement insists PO number must be visible in doc and attached to DocuSign. Also need AP email for invoice routing.
Anne (Sales Ops): I can build an envelope template. Prefer single envelope: Hooper procurement signs, Hooper tech cc, Redwood countersign.
Tom (Sales Eng): Mapping: procure@hooper.com = signer; ctech@hooper.com = cc; ap@hooper.com = copy.
Mike (Legal): DPA review notes: (a) they request customer-managed keys for hosted — we only offer CMK for Private; (b) explicit subprocessors approval for an Azure partner; (c) SLA they want 99.95% for POC which is heavy.
Dani (Legal Ops): Proposal: for Hosted POC replace CMK ask with KMS attestation appendix + SOC snapshot. For subprocessors we can add an approval addendum with 72h notice.
Raj (EngSec): Can draft a short KMS attestation (48h). Current subprocessors published here: https://internal.redwood/subprocessors (last updated 2026-03-01).
Mike (Legal): I'll redline the DPA to: - swap CMK ask for attestation appendix; - subprocessors addendum with approval workflow; - change absolute SLA language to "commercially reasonable efforts" + link to runbook/metrics.
Sarah (AE): Finance confirmed hosted POC pricing: free up to 30k tokens, then $0.0008/token. Call this out on order form.
Anne (Sales Ops): Draft order form linked: https://drive.redwood/hooper/orderform-draft-v1.pdf — placeholders left for PO_NUMBER, BILLING_ENTITY, SIGNER_FULLNAME.
Tom (Sales Eng): Tech note for order form: TERM = 30 days, MODEL = hosted-standard, SUPPORT = standard.
Mike (Legal): I will also annotate invoice terms: net 30 to ap@hooper.com and include split-billing language comment.
Dani (Legal Ops): I'll prepare DocuSign instructions: role names = "Hooper - Procurement (sign)", "Hooper - Technical (cc)", "Redwood Sales Ops (sign)". Anne, please prefill emails.
esign-bot: DocuSign template created tpl_b6c2a. Envelope ID: env_9938.
Anne (Sales Ops): Done. Template populated with emails. I left the PO_NUMBER field editable for customer.
Sarah (AE): Timeline check — can Mike/Dani post redlines and Raj upload attestation by EOD tomorrow? We need this to send envelope same day.
Raj (EngSec): Yes I'll have attestation + SOC snapshot by tomorrow AM.
Mike (Legal): I'll push redlines today and follow up if any major pushback.
Dani (Legal Ops): Targeting EOD tomorrow for final DPA + order form. If procurement needs faster, we can fast-track.
Sarah (AE): Thanks everyone. Checklist: 1) Mike/Dani upload redlines; 2) Raj upload attestation; 3) Anne finalize envelope; 4) I confirm POC mode with customer. Ping me for urgent items. :thumbsup:
